main_text.head: IN D. PAULI PRIOREM EPISTOLAM ad Timotheum commentarius.
main_text.l: IN QVO NON SOLVM IPsius Epistolæ doctrina, & artificium singulorumque argumentorum loci explicantur: sed etiam vera Disciplinæ Ecclesiasticæ forma, tum ex dei verbo, atque ex ipso Paulo, tum ex veteribus synodis repetita atque restituta est, ut legitima & Apostolica regendæ Dei Ecclesiæ ratio & norma hodie in vsum renocari possit.

page.notes: The woodcut anchor with a serpent-wrapped shaft is an engraving; its side legends read ANCHORA (left) and SACRA (right). Handwritten marks ("Sumar E", "Danaeum", "XIS 22877") are not printed and are omitted. The imprint line "APVD EVSTATHIVM VIGNON," is printed with a trailing comma-like mark as shown.
